warning.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover P530 Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The BMW N63 is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older BMW N63 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every BMW N63 rebuild.
Because the Range Rover P530 uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the Range Rover 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established BMW N63 specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
